newsitem.title: USA: New Castle Cty, Del., proposes development freeze.
newsitem.headline: New Castle Cty, Del., proposes development freeze.

text.p: New Castle County Executive Tom Gordon has proposed a six-month freeze on all new development, a plan he called "harmless" for local businesses.
The moratorium would take effect July 1 and last for six months if passed by the county council later this month.
The proposal includes a clause in the proposal which allows projects pending at the time the law passes to proceed.
Despite concerns from the governor's office and developers, the freeze has the support of the county council.
Gordon said he expects to have a comprehensive plan on controlling sprawling growth in New Castle County by the end of the year.
